data.title: 椎叶紬 · 终于能挑喜欢的颜色
data.description: 契约结束后的休息日，紬把新挑的缎带放到镜前，试了两次才系好。她转身看向你，故作镇定地问：“真的好看吗？”等听到回答，她才笑着把手递过来。
data.action: adjusting a hair ribbon and turning toward her partner
data.promptProse: In front of a dressing-room mirror, Tsumugi adjusts a ribbon in her hair and turns toward her partner with a shy smile.
data.animaCaption: She has just finished tying the ribbon and looks toward her partner.
